# Atlas CLI — Complete Architecture Guide

Comprehensive operational and internal analysis of Atlas CLI within MongoDB architectures.

## System Architecture & Invariants
- [HIGH] (core) Atlas CLI provides critical operational isolation and throughput guarantees.
- [HIGH] (antipatterns) Improper configuration of Atlas CLI causes query plan de-optimization under high concurrency.

## Primary Sources & Citations
- MongoDB Manual: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/ (docs)
- MongoDB Core Server Repo: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo (repo)
